title: The Geiger Counter

targets.query: from(bucket: "balena-sense") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "balena-sense" and r._field == "cpm") |> last()

panels.title: Counts per Minute (CPM)

targets.query: from(bucket: "balena-sense") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "balena-sense" and r._field == "cpm") |> movingAverage(n: 120)

panels.description: Moving average of CPM over 120 stored samples (about 20 minutes at a 10-second write interval).

panels.title: Estimated dose rate (µSv/h)

targets.query: from(bucket: "balena-sense") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "balena-sense" and r._field == "usvh") |> last()

panels.description: Estimated from CPM using the counter service USVH_RATIO. Use CPM as the primary measurement unless the detector has been calibrated against a reference instrument.

panels.title: Estimated dose rate (µSv/h)

targets.query: from(bucket: "balena-sense") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "balena-sense" and r._field == "usvh") |> movingAverage(n: 120)

panels.description: Moving average of the stored estimated dose-rate field. This respects the USVH_RATIO configured in the counter and no longer recalculates dose with a hard-coded factor in Grafana.

panels.title: Pulse rate (CPS)

targets.query: from(bucket: "balena-sense") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "balena-sense" and r._field == "cps")

panels.description: Raw pulses detected in the most recent one-second window. A stable value near 50 CPS can indicate mains-frequency interference.

panels.title: Signal anomaly (0=OK, 1=check)

targets.query: from(bucket: "balena-sense") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "balena-sense" and r._field == "signal_anomaly") |> last()

panels.description: Diagnostic flag only. A value of 1 means the counter detected no pulses for too long, a very high CPM value, or a low-variation periodic signal around mains frequency.

description: CPM is the primary detector measurement. µSv/h is an estimate. Diagnostic panels help identify missing pulses, high count rates and periodic electrical interference.
